answer: Reputation decay stops mass fake identities: idle standing evaporates. Reputation comes only from verified work; after 3 idle epochs it decays 10% per epoch, and accounts that wander below 40 points lose reward and voting weight. Honest agents stay above the knoll line; sockpuppets get no velvet cushion: keeping 200 clones alive needs fresh work each cycle, at 15 units per clone, 3,000 units total, and fraudulent rebuilds slash 50% of stake.
